policy: Append-only, primary-research or named specialist-synthesis claims. Original RC18 is immutable. Do not infer current local occupancy, global conservation status, species absence, modelled GPS locations, or generalize site-specific methods to all populations. Full original citations are in VerifiedApaCatalog by exact URL.

records.label: Documented island distribution
records.text: Published conservation research places the Philippine Eagle in remaining forest habitats on Luzon, Samar, Leyte and Mindanao; these island records do not establish presence at an individual sampling station.
records.source: Luczon et al. (2014), Journal of Threatened Taxa 6(10):6335–6344
records.studyScope: Historical and published island-level range summary in the 2014 genetic study. The paper sampled 22 individuals, not an exhaustive island occupancy survey; not a current locality polygon.

records.label: Northwest Panay survey records
records.text: Distance-sampling surveys documented 54 Visayan Hornbill encounters in the Northwest Panay Peninsula survey area, providing site-specific evidence from Panay rather than a complete geographic range map.
records.sourceLocation: Results, 367 ten-minute point counts over 204.4 km² of the Northwest Panay Peninsula
records.studyScope: One surveyed Northwest Panay area with 54 encounters, not all Panay, Negros, or the entire species range. No inference about current occurrence at another site.

records.label: Fruit feeding and occasional invertebrates
records.text: Fruit, including figs, forms the main recorded diet. Invertebrate prey such as snails, beetles and caterpillars is documented in smaller amounts.
records.source: IUCN SSC Hornbill Specialist Group, Rufous-headed Hornbill species account
records.sourceLocation: Habits and Food sections of the hornbill specialist species account
records.studyScope: Specialist-group synthesis, not a new controlled diet study. The source reports 98% fruit in breeding-season feeding context; no assumption about diets of all populations or life stages.

records.label: Observed social grouping on Mindoro
records.text: In dry-season monitoring at Mount Iglit–Baco during 2006–2011, 32.2% of adult bull sightings were solitary, and 94.7% of adult cow sightings involved groups of 2–12 animals.
records.sourceLocation: Abstract and social-behaviour results; repeated community-based dry-season vantage counts in Mount Iglit–Baco
records.studyScope: Percentages describe observed dry-season sightings in the studied conservation area during 2006–2011, not a universal year-round social structure or a current census.

records.label: Agusan Marsh voucher specimen
records.text: A documented Cuming’s Water Monitor specimen from Barangay San Marcos, Bunawan, Agusan del Sur, confirms a reviewed Mindanao locality within the Agusan Marsh survey treatment.
records.sourceLocation: Varanus cumingi treatment; KU 314128, Barangay San Marcos, Municipality of Bunawan, Agusan del Sur
records.studyScope: One published voucher locality, not an island-wide occupancy estimate. Coordinates and taxon label must not be copied into live observer GPS or inferred current detections.

records.label: Historical Busuanga and Palawan records
records.text: Historical specimen records include Busuanga Island and the Puerto Princesa area of Palawan; a 1978 museum specimen is attributed to Bat Island in Honda Bay.
records.source: Esselstyn, Widmann & Heaney (2004), Proceedings of the Biological Society of Washington 117(3):271–302
records.sourceLocation: Species treatment Acerodon leucotis, printed p. 280; cited original specimen records by Hoogstraal (1951), Sanborn (1952), and UMMZ material
records.studyScope: Historic specimen records assembled in 2004. Does not establish current occupation of any island, station, or habitat patch.

records.label: Busuanga forest context in earlier collections
records.text: A historical Busuanga collection locality included highly disturbed remnants of original forest alongside dense secondary growth.
records.source: Esselstyn, Widmann & Heaney (2004), Proceedings of the Biological Society of Washington 117(3):271–302
records.sourceLocation: Acerodon leucotis, printed p. 280, quoting a 1951 Busuanga field observation
records.studyScope: Habitat around a historical Busuanga locality, not a measured present-day preference, range-wide typical habitat, or proof of tolerance for all disturbed forest.

records.label: Field observations of canopy feeding
records.text: In Palawan surveys reviewed in 2004, one individual was netted about 5 m above ground, and other individuals were observed feeding in the canopy at approximately 8 m.
records.source: Esselstyn, Widmann & Heaney (2004), Proceedings of the Biological Society of Washington 117(3):271–302
records.sourceLocation: Acerodon leucotis, printed p. 280; Site 12 capture and canopy-feeding observations
records.studyScope: Field observations from one survey and locality; not a measured general feeding height or verified diet composition.
